projects.name: DevStudio
projects.tagline: An AI-powered learning and resource platform for modern developers
projects.description:
DevStudio is an AI-powered platform designed to help developers learn, build, and grow efficiently in the modern tech ecosystem. The platform provides curated resources, learning guidance, and a structured environment where developers can explore tools, workflows, and real-world development practices.

Built with a strong focus on user experience and scalability, DevStudio integrates secure authentication, real-time data handling, and AI-assisted features to enhance productivity and decision-making. The project is actively evolving with the goal of becoming a complete resource hub and community-driven learning platform for developers.
